mintAuthority.summary: USDS governance issuance is economically unbounded: the Sky Pause Proxy is a USDS ward and can mint arbitrary durable tokens directly without collateral, as well as create unbacked Vat.dai for USDS_JOIN.exit. The Chief/Pause route enforces 48 hours after plotting, but the complete 129-ward Vat inventory, savings accrual, allocator/relayer and emergency paths are not execution-certified; no governed-issuance credit is claimed.

Verified Chief.lock transfers SKY into the Chief and increases deposits/approval weight; vote uses deposits, not the voter's live wallet balance. free removes approval weight and requires block.number > last, while lift sets last, preventing same-block lift-and-release. Chief has no fixed vote duration; liftCooldown=10 constrains repeated lifts and the current unavoidable governance issuance delay is DSPause's 172800 seconds after plot. This is locked approval stake, not time-locked veSKY.

review.evidence: D14/D29 reviewed 2026-10-03 at Ethereum block 26112822, hash 0x9a43012d71f59ade74c58a438ae4cf7eba960288f5357ddd8203d3a0ac51042a. The prior pinned read-only Usds.mint(dead,1e18) simulation from Pause Proxy succeeded, and verified mint requires only token ward authorization with no collateral or numeric economic cap. Vat.suck from the same root also succeeded; USDS_JOIN.exit converts that unbacked credit to durable tokens. The former raiseable cap semantics are corrected to unbounded. Reconciliation and supervision remain not-applicable/none; incomplete governed evidence therefore derives unbounded-unreconciled, not compromise. Full-history Vat rely/deny census returned 158 logs, 144 distinct historical candidates and 129 live wards, with every latest event agreeing with pinned storage: 61 collateral joins, 47 clippers and 21 other modules. All 129 returned verified sources; 128 runtimes matched exactly, while CRVV1ETHSTETH Clipper 0x1926862f899410bfc19fefb8a3c69c7aed22463a lacks a usable deployed-bytecode field. D29 remains uncertified for the full ward set, including Pot/Jug drip, D3M exec/uncull, DAI/USDS vesting, Teleport, STUSDS, Lockstake, Kicker/Flopper, Auto-Line and LineMom; End.snip/skip use suck and ESM is not certified restriction-only. Vow downstream accounting, LitePSM.fill, all Allocator draw paths and Spark ALM relayers have incomplete ceiling/admin/bypass closure. sUSDS is itself a Vat ward whose public drip creates parent USDS through suck and exit; its live SPBEAM/Pause rate and upgrade authorities lack a complete parent-issuance certificate. SPBEAM is a verified bounded rate-setting delegate, not a demonstrated share minter; its complete facilitator/admin scope is still missing. Public USDS_JOIN.exit has no delay against existing credit and cannot claim governance as its only caller. Chief votes use escrowed SKY, with no fixed voting duration and the enforced 48-hour Pause on the proven governor path. The exact ward inventory and path gaps are retained in U2SkyGoverned's research result; authored scopes intentionally remain partial.
